relations.subject: Edward Denison Ross
relations.object: University of London's School of Oriental Studies
relations.evidence: He was the first director of the University of London's School of Oriental Studies (now SOAS, University of London) from 1916 to 1937.

relations.subject: Edward Denison Ross
relations.evidence: Ross joined the staff of the British Museum in 1914, appointed to catalogue the collections of Sir Aurel Stein.

relations.subject: Edward Denison Ross
relations.evidence: Along with Eileen Power, he wrote and edited a 26-volume series published by George Routledge & Sons, The Broadway Travellers.
